description: List membership or subscription plans (Wix Pricing Plans). Pass `place_slug` (from search_places) to list the plans of a specific VENUE — a gym, studio or clinic listed in this directory (e.g. its monthly/annual membership); that is what you want in almost every case. Omitting `place_slug` lists the directory site's own plans instead, which most sites do not have. Returns plan name, description, price, billing cycle, perks, and a direct checkout URL.

place_slug.description: Venue place slug from search_places. Strongly recommended — without it you get the directory's own plans, not a venue's.

name: list_pricing_plans
